depletion_rules.rules: When this dies, it revives next turn at full HP.

encounter_progress.consequence: Illusion replaces death with a revival move at full HP next turn and grants Minion. Partial damage neither cancels its current attack nor defeats it. Depletion interrupts its current attack but does not permanently remove it while a primary enemy remains.

conclusions.improved: Obscura turn 4: baseline 2/2 dealt 19 damage to a 21 HP reviving minion without knockdown; adopted 2/2 dealt 19 to the leader instead, with the same 25 Block.
unresolved: Hunter Killer plan changed to Strike, Taunt, Stone Armor+, observe; no completed counterfactual establishes superiority.
Vantom initial plan Defend, Strike, Defend, end omits free Battle Trance. A later end-turn review was not run in this replay; no superiority over draw plans is established.
Finalist comparisons disagree in 7 of 18 unordered pairs when their presentation order is reversed; confidence is recorded but not calibrated to correctness.
Independent search and earlier elimination remain bounded; unknown mechanics and future observed states are not simulated.
Obscura planning uses 40 requests instead of 29; mean input tokens rise from 621524 to 929394.
conclusions.rejected: Shared plan catalog saved about 2.3% input versus the initial direct layout, but both Obscura repetitions split attacks between leader and reviving minion. Reverted; raw intermediate outputs retained. This observation alone is not statistical causality.
